header.title: Suppl. Mag. 61: Magical curse / juridicial prayer: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Supplementum Magicum
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:64397:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1: ποίησον τὸ ἱκανόν μου, ‘give me satisfaction’, is the idiom for obtaining redress. μέγα at the end of line 1 probably goes with ‘Lord God’ in line 2. Letters the scribe deleted in line 3 (⟦ο⟧, ⟦υ⟧) are left out; the opening * * * stands as printed.

nodes.text: * * * Holy is God! Gabriel, Michael, give me satisfaction; great
Lord God, strike Philadelphe; and her children,
Lord, Lord, Lord God, God, strike [them] along with her. O
[J]esus Christ, have mercy on me and hear me, Lord.
